title: feat(infrastructure): implement urban infrastructure asset registry, condition inspection, health scoring, streetlight control, and waste collection scheduling
author: SmartCity360 Architecture Team
problem: Municipal public works and utility boards lacked a unified engine to record physical asset health, log formal condition grading inspections, manage streetlight operational telemetry, and process scheduled bulk waste pickups.
solution: Built InfrastructureService managing physical assets with auto-generated tags (AST-BRID, AST-ROAD, AST-PIPE), condition grading (GOOD, FAIR, POOR, CRITICAL) with automated 0-100 health score recalculations, streetlight operational state toggling and bulb maintenance tracking, water network distribution queries, and residential bulk waste collection scheduling.
security_considerations: Role-gated inspection logging, validated asset tags, and authenticated citizen pickup requests.
